newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Shell Manila unit signs 6.484 bln peso fuel pact.
newsitem.headline: Shell Manila unit signs 6.484 bln peso fuel pact.

text.p: Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp (PSPC), a unit of Royal Dutch Shell, signed on Monday a 6.484 billion peso contract to supply fuel oil to the state-run National Power Corp (Napocor).
Napocor President Guido A. Delgado and PSPC President Reinier Willems signed the two-year agreement under which Napocor will purchase 912 million litres of fuel oil annually.
In a statement, Napocor said the contract takes effect on January 16, 1997.
Earlier, Napocor signed a 16 billion peso fuel supply agreement with another oil refiner Petron Corp.
Napocor said Pilipinas Shell will account for 22.48 percent of Napocor's fuel requirements.
